name: Quantum Healthcare Limited
summary: Quantum Healthcare Limited, a Singapore-based enterprise established in 2005, specializes in the design, assembly, and commercialization of sophisticated therapeutic solutions for the minimally invasive management of intricate vascular diseases. The company conducts its operations across several divisions: its Vascular Business is dedicated to the development, production, and distribution of medical devices; the Healthcare Business segment provides comprehensive dental services; and a Corporate division handles general corporate functions. Beyond these core activities, Quantum Healthcare also offers management consultancy expertise to other healthcare organizations. The firm officially adopted its current moniker, Quantum Healthcare Limited, in July 2022, having previously traded as QT Vascular Ltd.
